question: Which members of the fixed original-selected P7 response branch are individually necessary for its exact OOD composition with the block-10 residual identity stream?
population: The immutable OOD FIT/HOLDOUT rows from the stable P7-plus-identity parent; no row, module, threshold, or ordering may be selected from these outcomes.

fixed_program.identity_stream: Install the selected-writer block-10 residual input over each row's exact causal prefix.
fixed_program.full_arm: Install all seven selected-writer module outputs in the identity background.
fixed_program.leave_one_out_arms: For each fixed P7 member, leave that one module native/live while installing the other six selected-writer outputs in the same identity background.
fixed_program.necessity_measure: full-arm signed recovery minus leave-one-out signed recovery, computed separately on frozen OOD FIT and HOLDOUT.
fixed_program.interpretation: This is operational necessity within the installed P7 program, not a Shapley value and not proof that a native module is a semantic atom. Passing A11 licenses head splitting; passing MLPs license exact activation-conditioned Left/Right/interaction weight-factor splitting.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capture_full_replay_fin: Immutable parent hashes and P7 order match; capture hooks and every installed arm fire exactly once; the full P7-plus-identity arm replays the parent within 1e-5; exact price and finiteness pass.
predictions.pred_b_at_least_two_p7_modules_are_stabl: At least two fixed P7 members have a full-minus-LOO signed-recovery drop >=.03 on both OOD FIT and HOLDOUT.
predictions.pred_c_attention11_is_stably_necessary_a: Leaving A11 out loses >=.03 signed recovery on both OOD phases.
predictions.pred_d_at_least_one_p7_mlp_is_stably_nec: At least one of M11/M12/M15/M13/M16/M10 loses >=.03 signed recovery on both OOD phases.
predictions.pred_e_every_leave_one_out_arm_is_tempor: Every LOO arm has temporal command-gold collateral <=.01 on both OOD phases.

terminal_rules.nonminimal_sufficient_bundle: A and E pass but B fails; use frozen backward pruning before native-unit splitting.
terminal_rules.mlp_only_necessity: A/B/D/E pass and C fails; drop or defer A11 and split necessary MLPs only.
terminal_rules.attention_only_necessity: A/B/C/E pass and D fails; split A11 heads and treat P7 MLP membership as distributed/redundant.
terminal_rules.stable_cross_module_necessity: A--E all pass; split A11 into heads and the necessary MLPs into exact activation-conditioned weight factors.

tripwires: No OOD reselection, greedy deletion, threshold tuning, DAS fitting, or learned subspace is allowed.
Each LOO arm must omit exactly one fixed P7 clamp while leaving that native module live; omitting its computation entirely is a different intervention.
All bars and predictions are frozen before reading any LOO outcome.
A module passing necessity remains a proposed boundary and must be split at native heads or exact activation-conditioned MLP factors before a semantic-unit claim.
